## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `574169bbe78a4e0b47fd9bcdf666fd208f72de6b`

Isolated adversarial review of objectui#10558 (card objectui#10425). Read set: the card body and its three comments (the `os-dev-report` was not used as evidence), triage `5827478367`, claim `5828730386`, the cited cards #10024 / #10240 / #10242 / #9664 / #10453 and PR #10415, `AGENTS.md` (版本号策略 and the changeset-presence rule), `.changeset/config.json`, and the code via `refs/review/pr-10558` and `refs/review/main` only. Merge-base with current `main` (`1434bb4`) is `fee1da5`. The diff is 6 files, +549 / -14; the REST file list and `git diff --numstat` agree. Every line number below is at the head.

### ① Derived judgments

**1. The seven value changes, each against the card table and the ruled device.** The card's rulings bind: the objectui#10024 / #10240 / #10242 count label (「a label, a colon, then the number」) and 「⛔ No `_few` / `_two` key: `all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` holds every pack to `en`'s key set」. Every consumer's switch was re-read at source.

| key | pack | head value (file:line) | consumer switch at head | judgment |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `list.recordCount` | ru | `Записей: {{count}}` (ru.ts:659) | ListView.tsx:5118-5120 `totalCount === 1` | RIGHT: same form as ru `lookup.recordCount` (ru.ts:73), already `Записей: {{count}}` |
| `list.recordCount` | ar | `عدد السجلات: {{count}}` (ar.ts:660, section `list`) | same | RIGHT |
| `lookup.recordCount` | ar | `عدد السجلات: {{count}}` (ar.ts:74, section `lookup`) | RecordPickerDialog.tsx:1325 `totalCount === 1` | RIGHT |
| `detail.reactionCount` | ar | `{{emoji}} عدد التفاعلات: {{count}}` (ar.ts:951, section `detail`) | ReactionPicker.tsx:60 `reaction.count === 1` | RIGHT: the `عدد التفاعلات: N` phrase of ar `collaboration.reactionCount` (ar.ts:3648, from #10415), emoji kept |
| `collaboration.presentUserCount` | ar | `عدد المستخدمين المتواجدين: {{count}}` (ar.ts:3662) | PresenceAvatars.tsx:168-170 `users.length === 1` | RIGHT |
| `collaboration.moreUserCount` | ar | `عدد المستخدمين الآخرين: {{count}}` (ar.ts:3664) | PresenceAvatars.tsx:179-181 `overflowCount === 1` | RIGHT |
| `search.itemsAvailable` | ar | `عدد العناصر المتاحة: {{count}}` (ar.ts:2540, section `search`) | SearchResultsPage.tsx:245 `allItems.length === 1` | RIGHT |

- Before-values match the card table byte for byte (the seven `-` lines of the pack diff). Each new value carries exactly one `{{count}}` hole, ends in a colon then the count, and differs from its `…One` half (checked in node over the head values). The singular halves are untouched.
- The shape is the ruled one: #10024 `عدد نتائج البحث عن "…": N`, #10242 `عدد العناصر: N` / `عدد التعليقات: N` / `عدد التفاعلات: N`, and ru `Записей: N` / `Комментариев: N`.
- CLDR re-measured (node 22.22, ICU 78.2, CLDR 48): ru 2 few, 5 many, 21 one; ar 2 two, 3 few, 11 many. The card's, the triage's and the pin's representative counts reach exactly the categories claimed.

**2. Key set and accepted set: unchanged.** The pack diff, filtered to key lines, is exactly seven removed and seven added lines with identical key names (`recordCount` x3, `reactionCount`, `presentUserCount`, `moreUserCount`, `itemsAvailable`); no key added or removed anywhere, no `_few` / `_two` / `_one` / `_other` key introduced. The parity assertion 「defines no key that en lacks」 (all-locales-key-parity.test.ts:137) is untouched and unthreatened. The other eight packs are not in the diff. No consumer file is in the diff.

**3. The eighth row is dead, and leaving it out is right, not a missing ask.** ar `detail.revisionFieldsChanged` and its consumer `PointInTimeRestore` are absent from the packs and from every `src/` at the merge-base `fee1da5` and at the head (the only `git grep` hit is a header comment in detailTimestamps.displayLocale-9786.test.tsx). Commit `0348bc9` (#10453, 「delete seven unregistered, unmounted exports」) deleted `PointInTimeRestore.tsx` and 27 lines from each of ar.ts and ru.ts; `git merge-base --is-ancestor 0348bc9 fee1da5` exits 0. The PR body says so.

**4. Asked and done; done and not asked.**
- Asked: seven of eight values (the eighth gone, item 3); a pin beside `countLabels.ruAr-10242.test.tsx` in its shape (new file `packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/countLabels.ruAr-10425.test.tsx`, 480 lines); the 9664 changeset's last sentence reworded (triage execution note 「Retire or reword … if it is still pending」; it is pending on `main`); one `.changeset/10425-…md`. Missing: nothing.
- Not in the claim's literal file surface: `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/searchItemsAvailable-plural-9664.test.ts`. It is inside the card's named sites (grading note: 「`ar` `search.itemsAvailable` is also pinned in `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/searchItemsAvailable-plural-9664.test.ts`」), the flip is unavoidable (that pin asserts the exact ar value), and the PR body declares it under 「Flipped」. Recorded as a surface note for the seat; not a defect.
- Also added: one comment block at each changed value (ar.ts:71-73, 657-659, 948-950, 2538-2539, 3659-3661; ru.ts:656-658). They cite by card number and key name, no line addresses. Fine.

**5. The one existing pin edited: load-bearing, not weakened.** In `searchItemsAvailable-plural-9664.test.ts` the `PLURAL.ar` row (line 73) moves from the old value to the new one, and two comments (57-62, 155-158) are reworded. The row is an exact-equality assertion (`%s defines both halves`) on the very value this PR changes, so the flip is forced; it still asserts exact equality on the new value. The other legs still do work on the new value: `ONE.ar` (`{{count}} عنصر متاح`) differs from `PLURAL.ar`; the parenthesised-marker leg holds; the no-suffix leg holds. Nothing is deleted. A sweep of every test and snapshot at head for the six old-value fragments finds them only in the two `countLabels.ruAr-*` pins' negative legs, so no other guard held the old values.

**6. The new pin can fail.**
- Lit controls: `boot()` asserts `i18n.language` equals the language under test; `en` rows on all six surfaces; `ru` rows on the picker, presence name and overflow (values this PR does not touch, ru.ts:73, 3656, 3658); the `Intl.PluralRules` category assertion; `toHaveLength(1)` element-found guards on every finder.
- Negative legs: 「ru no longer binds the many-form noun to a few or one count」 (`not.toBe('2 записей')`, `'21 записей'`) and 「ar no longer binds one noun form to a dual or an 11+ count」 naming eight shipped strings; the count-invariance test on the seven pack values (`/: \{\{count\}\}$/` and `not.toBe` the One half).
- Positive legs assert exact rendered strings at ru 2 / 5 / 21 and ar 2 / 3 / 11 on every changed value; reverting any one value reddens its rows. Row arithmetic: 21 changed-value rows plus the two named-defect tests plus the invariance test is 24 in this file, plus the 9664 `ar defines both halves` row is 25, which is the PR body's reverse-verification count; the file holds 53 cases and the 9664 file 16, and 25 + 44 = 69.
- CI executed it at the head: all eight `Test (shard n/8)` runs succeeded.

**7. Published surface.** `const ar = {` (ar.ts:1) and `const ru = {` (ru.ts:1) carry no `as const` (only en.ts:4258 does), so every pack string is emitted as `string` and no `.d.ts` byte moves; `builtInLocales` (locales/index.ts:45) is untouched. No export, prop, registry entry, call site or accept set changes.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/10425-ru-ar-count-labels.md`: `'@object-ui/i18n': patch`. RIGHT. A user-visible locale-value fix in a fixed-group package; AGENTS.md 版本号策略 forbids `major` (satisfied) and lets minor/patch evolve independently; the same level as the accepted #10024 and #10242 changesets for the same device. `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check` and `Changeset Declaration` all success at head.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: the only change is a test file under `src/`. The presence gate (`scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` header: 「the same change must declare a `.changeset/*.md`. An EMPTY frontmatter counts」) needs one declaration per change and has it; no app-shell entry is owed, as the #10415 review also ruled for its pin.
- Not a docs-only change; nothing under `content/docs/**` is touched, so no empty-frontmatter changeset is owed.
- Changeset prose, sentence by sentence:
  - 「Russian now reads correctly at every count on the list view's record-count bar, and Arabic on that bar, the record picker's count, the activity-feed reaction chip, the presence avatars' accessible name and overflow tooltip, and the full-page search count while browsing」: TRUE (item 1; `ReactionPicker` is mounted by RecordActivityTimeline.tsx, the activity feed; the presence key feeds the group `aria-label` and the overflow badge `title`, PresenceAvatars.tsx:168-181).
  - 「Each of these surfaces picks its `…One` key at exactly one and the plain key at every other count」: TRUE (the five `=== 1` switches in item 1).
  - 「Where the plain key held a single noun form, it was wrong at some of the counts it serves」: TRUE.
  - 「The Russian record-count bar read `2 записей` at two (the language needs `2 записи`) and `21 записей` at twenty-one (it needs `21 запись`)」: TRUE (few = записи, one = запись).
  - 「The Arabic values each held one noun form (the plural for three to ten, or in `lookup.recordCount` the singular)」: TRUE (`سجلات`, `تفاعلات`, `مستخدمين …`, `عناصر متاحة` are the 3-10 plurals; `lookup.recordCount` was `{{count}} سجل`).
  - 「Arabic needs different forms at two, at three to ten and from eleven up」: TRUE.
  - 「The count-not-one half of these seven values is now a count label that reads correctly at any number」 and the seven bullet values: TRUE, each bullet matches the head value.
  - 「That is the device objectui#10024 and objectui#10242 used, and the one Russian's `lookup.recordCount` already uses」: TRUE (ru.ts:73 was `Записей: {{count}}` at the merge-base and is unchanged).
  - 「The singular halves, the key set, the call sites and the other eight packs are unchanged」: TRUE (item 2).
- `.changeset/9664-search-items-available-plural.md`: frontmatter byte-identical (the diff touches lines 33-38 only). The new last sentence, 「It now reads as a singular noun at one item and as a count label at every other count, the shape `ar`'s `common.itemCount`/`itemCountOne` uses (objectui#10425)」: TRUE (ar `itemCountOne` `{{count}} عنصر` / `itemCount` `عدد العناصر: {{count}}` at ar.ts:131-132 is the same singular-noun / count-label shape as `itemsAvailableOne` / `itemsAvailable` at ar.ts:2540-2541). The sentence #10415's review judged loosened is retired, as triage asked.
- No README or docs prose is added. Pack and test comments: TRUE, with two imprecisions that are not false and do not block: the new pin's header 「other 100+」 (CLDR ar gives 100-102 other, 103-110 few, 111-199 many; the 10242 pin wrote 「100-102…」), and the 9664 test's `PLURAL` doc comment 「serves two, few, many and other」 omits `zero`, which the browse count does reach at zero nav items. The ar.ts lookup and list comments' omission of zero is exact: both surfaces render only when the count is above zero (RecordPickerDialog.tsx:1319 gates on `totalCount` being positive; ListView.tsx:5106 gates on `data.length` being positive).

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The PR body's own flags.**
  - 「seven values change, not eight」: TRUE (item 3).
  - The 9664 changeset edit is 「case 2, prose correction」 under `check-changeset-overwrite`: TRUE. The script's printed guidance names case 2 as 「CORRECTING a declaration on purpose — a bump level after review, a wrong package name, prose that no longer matches the change. Legitimate」; the gate is report-only; `Changeset Overwrite Report` success at head.
  - Acceptance note, ru `search.itemsAvailable` `{{count}} доступно` unchanged: TRUE (ru.ts:2540); it states no noun, so there is nothing to agree.
  - Acceptance note, `detail.relatedRecords` / `relatedRecordOne` has no reader: TRUE. `git grep` at head finds no `t(` call on the pair; the hits are the useDetailTranslation.ts:90-91 defaults rows, comments, CHANGELOGs, and an unrelated local variable name in RelatedList.userColumnNames-10112.test.tsx. Leaving it is right.
  - Acceptance note, `console.objectView.recordCount` is a separate defect: TRUE that it is one key with no One sibling and no switch (en.ts:2256 `'{{count}} records'`; ObjectView.tsx:3389 `t('console.objectView.recordCount', { count: recordCount })`). Outside the card; correctly not changed here.
  - The body's local-verification numbers (vitest counts, gates, eslint, the app-shell type-check measured at `35c233b`) are the dev's runs and cannot be verified from the diff; what CI re-measures at the head is green (Lint, Type Check, the eight Test shards, the changeset gates, Control Byte Scan, Line Citation Gate). The eslint claim 「no type-aware parser options」 checks: 0 hits for `TypeChecked` / `projectService` / `parserOptions` in eslint.config.js at head. The second merge (`574169b`) changes nothing in the six-file diff against `fee1da5`.
